BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Health Care.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning the availability of childhood immunization resources for expecting parents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing information regarding childhood immunizations to expecting parents; and adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The department shall develop and make available resources for expecting parents regarding recommended childhood immunizations. The resources are intended to be provided to expecting parents by their health care providers to encourage discussion on childhood immunizations and postnatal care.
